def align(p):
    u = one(p['u'])
    v = p['v']
    rng = np.random.default_rng(721)
    best = None
    for _ in range(1000):
        i = rng.choice(len(u), 5, False)
        b = ls(u[i], v[i])
        r = np.linalg.norm(u @ b - v, axis=1)
        score = np.sort(r)[:34].mean()
        if best is None or score < best[0]:
            best = (score, b)
    b = best[1]
    for _ in range(5):
        r = np.linalg.norm(u @ b - v, axis=1)
        keep = r < max(4 * np.median(r), 0.001)
        b = ls(u[keep], v[keep])
    return (b, r)
